summary.en: Denser riffs, higher gain, technique-focused subculture.
summary.zh: 更密的 Riff、更高 Gain、以技巧为中心的亚文化。

body.en: Metal splits from Hard Rock into its own aesthetic and touring circuit. Technique, volume, and darker lyrical themes run in parallel as the style hits MTV and arena charts in the eighties.
body.zh: Metal 从 Hard Rock 裂出独立美学与巡演线路。技巧、音量与更暗的歌词主题并行，并在 80 年代进入 MTV 与体育馆榜单。
